name: Naranol
summary: Naranol (W-5494A) is a drug having a tetracyclic structure. It was synthesized in the late 1960s, and was reported to have antidepressant, anxiolytic, and antipsychotic activities, but was never marketed.

uses.text: It was synthesized in the late 1960s, and was reported to have antidepressant, anxiolytic, and antipsychotic activities, but was never marketed.

summaryZh: 萘拉諾（英語：Naranol，開發代號：W-5494A），分子式C18H21NO2，是一種含氮四環化合物，1960年代首次合成，能有抗抑鬱、抗焦慮、抗精神病作用，從未上市銷售。

fact.en: Naranol has an unusual cage-like tetracyclic skeleton and was one of many compounds made in the late 1960s in the search for new antipsychotics. It never reached the market.
fact.zh: 萘拉諾具有少見的籠狀四環骨架，是 1960 年代末尋找新型抗精神病藥時合成的眾多化合物之一，最終從未上市。
fact.zhHans: 萘拉诺具有少见的笼状四环骨架，是 1960 年代末寻找新型抗精神病药时合成的众多化合物之一，最终从未上市。
